scientific_question: Within a geographically and ecologically restricted Palearctic terrestrial-insect panel, do species pairs with more similar Last Glacial Maximum climatic-refugial opportunity show more similar post-IBD spatial genetic differentiation?
fresh_hypothesis: Higher overlap of independently reconstructed LGM climatic suitability predicts greater source-to-target transfer of post-IBD genetic differentiation after controlling present-day climatic similarity, current geographic opportunity, taxonomy, sampling imbalance, and exact source/target identity.

relationship_to_prior_TTF.claim_status: prospectively specified secondary analysis on an existing genetic data source; not an independent fresh-data confirmatory replication

source_binding.parent_species_source: species.train_species union species.eval_species in the exact frozen Phase-4 authorization
source_binding.marker: the unique COI row in genes.txt for each of the 211 parent survivors

taxonomy.rationale: Conservative terrestrial-core definition fixed before formal realm census; aquatic-major insect orders and mixed Diptera are excluded rather than classified after results.

independent_occurrences.geospatial_issue_rule: exclude records with invalid geospatial status under the existing TTF external-occurrence contract
independent_occurrences.priority: deterministic response-blind priority; no genetic quantity enters record choice

sdm.name: fixed regularized presence-background climatic SDM
sdm.background_selection: Target-group background: pool retained response-blind GBIF coordinates from the frozen 143-species taxonomic parent that fall inside the formal Palearctic terrestrial realm; map to 0.25-degree cells, deduplicate cells, then take up to 20,000 cells by SHA256('palearctic-insect-lgm-background-v0.2|<lon>|<lat>') rank. The same background is used for every species.
sdm.predictor_standardization: means and population SDs from the fixed current Palearctic background
sdm.clamping: each standardized climate predictor clipped to the pooled current-background 0.5th-99.5th percentile before prediction
sdm.suitability_normalization: clip numerical underflow then normalize positive predictions to sum 1 across Palearctic terrestrial cells separately for current and LGM projections
sdm.background_rationale: Presence-only records share collection bias across the same broad insect target group; target-group background is frozen before any SDM relation, TTF-Q qualification, or subpanel genetic response.
sdm.presence_background_interpretation: Relative suitability / relative intensity only; no prevalence claim.
sdm.presence_points: For each formally eligible species, use only its retained response-blind GBIF occurrences whose coordinates fall inside the formal Palearctic terrestrial-realm polygon; out-of-realm retained points contribute only to the 0.80 eligibility fraction and are excluded from SDM fitting.
sdm.minimum_palearctic_presence_points_ratio: A species has at least 30 retained GBIF points and at least 0.80 Palearctic fraction, so the frozen eligibility rule implies at least 24 in-realm presence points; no additional post-census sample-size tuning is authorized.

primary_relation.name: R_LGM
primary_relation.definition: Schoener D between source and target normalized LGM SDM suitability surfaces
primary_relation.refugium_language: interpret as shared LGM climatic-refugial opportunity, not direct proof of realized glacial refugia

declared_controls_in_order: z_R_current: Schoener D between current SDM suitability surfaces
z_geographic_coop: directed fraction of target GBIF coordinates with nearest source coordinate <=500 km

ttf_q_measurement_layer.bootstrap: resample retained GBIF occurrences within species with replacement; refit fixed SDM and rebuild R_LGM on unchanged dyads

ttf_q_qualification.rationale: Opening requires at least the known-truth broad-reference-quality detectability domain; endpoint concentration remains a separately reported diagnostic rather than an effective sample-size gate.

authorized_response_if_and_only_if_quali.response: freshly recomputed source-to-target post-IBD spatial genetic transfer score T_st restricted to the frozen Palearctic-insect panel and its new hash-assigned roles
authorized_response_if_and_only_if_quali.primary_model: T_st ~ z_R_LGM + declared controls + exact source FE + exact target FE
authorized_response_if_and_only_if_quali.if_qualification_fails: CLOSE_AS_NOT_EVALUABLE_PALEARCTIC_INSECT_LGM; do not compute subpanel T_st or beta_LGM

interpretation_boundary: A positive beta_LGM would support greater transfer of post-IBD spatial genetic structure among species with more similar LGM climatic suitability geography within this selected Palearctic terrestrial-insect panel.
It would not prove that all species occupied the modeled refugia, identify a single named refugium, or establish causality of glacial history.
A qualification failure is a design result, not evidence against refugial concordance.
This secondary analysis reuses a genetic source whose global Phase-4 result has already been opened; it must not be presented as an independent fresh-data replication.
The SDM uses target-group background to reduce shared GBIF sampling bias; remaining occurrence bias and palaeoclimate-model uncertainty remain limitations.
